collection.title: Collection & receipt
collection.subtitle: Scan tubes at phlebotomy (collect) and at the unit (receive). Results can be entered only on received samples.
collection.hint.collect: Collect mode: the tube is marked Collected with your name, branch and time.
collection.hint.collectAndReceive: Collect mode: auto-receive is on, so a collected tube is also marked Received.
collection.hint.receive: Receive mode: the tube is marked Received; a tube not scanned at phlebotomy is recorded as collected first.
collection.bulkSubtitle: Collect or receive every tube of a visit at once.
collection.accessionRequired: Enter or scan an accession number.
collection.empty: No samples match the filter today.

scan.placeholder: Scan or type the sample number…

visit.title: Samples by visit
visit.subtitle: The tubes of a visit with their status; reprint labels and the job order.
visit.accessionPlaceholder: Scan or type the accession number…
visit.notFoundHint: Check the accession number; reserved services have no tube until they are released.
visit.startHint: Scan the accession barcode of the job order or type the number.
labels.title: Labels
reject.title: Reject sample
reject.message: Reject {number}? Results cannot be entered on a rejected sample and reception is notified to recollect.
reject.reasonsUnavailable: The rejection reasons could not be loaded. Define them under Setup › Reasons.
unreject.title: Reinstate sample
unreject.message: Reinstate {number} with the same barcode? It returns to Received.
replace.title: Replace sample
replace.message: Replace {number} with a new sample and a new barcode? The rejected sample is kept on record.
replace.created: New sample {number} created. Print its label for the new tube.
rejections.title: Reject / unreject
rejections.subtitle: Reject unfit tubes with a reason, then reinstate or replace them.
rejections.policyNewBarcode: Laboratory policy: a rejected sample is replaced with a new barcode (reinstating the same barcode is off).
rejections.policyReinstate: Laboratory policy: a rejected sample may be reinstated with the same barcode or replaced with a new one.
rejections.noAction: A sample in status "{status}" cannot be rejected.
tracking.title: Sample tracking
tracking.subtitle: Where a tube was and when: every step with user, branch and time.
tracking.timelineHint: The time since the previous step is shown next to each step.
tracking.startHint: Scan the tube barcode or type the sample number.
